subject: math.MP
name: Noether's first theorem
statement: Every differentiable one-parameter variational symmetry of a smooth Lagrangian action gives a current whose divergence vanishes along solutions of the Euler–Lagrange equations. In ordinary mechanics this yields a conserved quantity.

subject: math.MP
name: Euler–Lagrange theorem
statement: For a C² Lagrangian L, a twice continuously differentiable path that is stationary for the action ∫L(t,q,q′) dt under all smooth variations with fixed endpoints satisfies d/dt(∂L/∂q′) = ∂L/∂q. Conversely, a path satisfying these equations is stationary under those variations.

subject: math.MP
name: Liouville's theorem for Hamiltonian flows
statement: A Hamiltonian flow on a 2n-dimensional symplectic manifold preserves the symplectic volume form ωⁿ/n!, wherever the flow is defined.

subject: math.MP
name: Darboux's theorem
statement: Near every point of a 2n-dimensional symplectic manifold there are local coordinates (q₁,…,qₙ,p₁,…,pₙ) in which the symplectic form is ∑ᵢ dqᵢ ∧ dpᵢ.

subject: math.MP
name: Stone's theorem on unitary groups
statement: Every strongly continuous one-parameter unitary group U(t) on a complex Hilbert space has a unique self-adjoint generator A with U(t) = exp(itA). Conversely, every self-adjoint operator generates such a group.

references.title: Stone's theorem on one-parameter unitary groups

subject: math.MP
name: Spectral theorem for self-adjoint operators
statement: Every self-adjoint operator A on a complex Hilbert space has a unique projection-valued measure E on the real line such that A = ∫λ dE(λ), with its natural square-integrability domain. This representation defines measurable functional calculus for A.

subject: math.MP
name: Stone–von Neumann theorem
statement: For finitely many canonical position–momentum pairs and a fixed nonzero value of Planck's constant, every regular irreducible unitary representation of the Weyl canonical commutation relations is unitarily equivalent to the Schrödinger representation.

subject: math.MP
name: Wigner's theorem
statement: Every bijection of the rays of a complex Hilbert space of dimension at least two that preserves transition probabilities is induced by a unitary or antiunitary operator.

subject: math.MP
name: Kato–Rellich theorem
statement: If A is self-adjoint and B is symmetric on the domain of A with ||Bψ|| ≤ a||Aψ|| + b||ψ|| for constants a < 1 and b ≥ 0, then A + B is self-adjoint on the domain of A.

references.title: Perturbation Theory for Linear Operators — Tosio Kato

subject: math.MP
name: Friedrichs extension theorem
statement: Every densely defined symmetric operator on a Hilbert space that is bounded below has a self-adjoint extension with the same lower bound, called its Friedrichs extension.

subject: math.MP
name: Lax–Milgram theorem
statement: For a bounded coercive sesquilinear form a on a Hilbert space and a bounded conjugate-linear functional ℓ, there is a unique u satisfying a(u,v) = ℓ(v) for every v. Coercivity means Re a(v,v) ≥ c||v||² for some c > 0.

subject: math.MP
name: Lumer–Phillips theorem
statement: A densely defined closed operator A on a Hilbert space generates a strongly continuous contraction semigroup if and only if Re⟨Ax,x⟩ ≤ 0 on its domain and λI−A is onto for some λ > 0.

subject: math.MP
name: Feynman–Kac formula
statement: For H = −Δ/2 + V on Euclidean space with bounded continuous real potential V, its heat semigroup satisfies (e⁻ᵗᴴf)(x) = Eₓ[exp(−∫₀ᵗ V(Bₛ) ds)f(Bₜ)] for bounded continuous f, where B is standard Brownian motion starting at x.

subject: math.MP
name: Weyl's eigenvalue law
statement: For the Dirichlet Laplacian on a bounded smooth domain Ω in Euclidean n-space, the number N(λ) of eigenvalues at most λ, counted with multiplicity, satisfies N(λ) ~ ωₙ Vol(Ω) λⁿ⁄²/(2π)ⁿ as λ tends to infinity.

subject: math.MP
name: Courant nodal domain theorem
statement: On a bounded connected smooth domain, the kth Dirichlet Laplacian eigenfunction in an eigenbasis ordered by nondecreasing eigenvalue has at most k nodal domains, the connected regions on which it is nonzero.

references.title: Nodal Decompositions of Graphs — John C. Urschel, Theorem 1.1 (Courant)

subject: math.MP
name: Min–max principle
statement: For a self-adjoint operator bounded below with compact resolvent, its kth eigenvalue counted with multiplicity equals the infimum, over k-dimensional subspaces of its quadratic-form domain, of the supremum of the Rayleigh quotient on nonzero vectors in the subspace.

subject: math.MP
name: Perron–Frobenius theorem
statement: A nonzero irreducible matrix with nonnegative real entries has a positive spectral radius that is an algebraically simple eigenvalue, with a strictly positive eigenvector. Every other eigenvalue has modulus at most the spectral radius.

subject: math.MP
name: Lieb–Robinson bound
statement: For a quantum spin system on an integer lattice with finite-dimensional on-site spaces and uniformly bounded finite-range interactions, the commutator of initially disjoint local observables under time evolution is bounded by a constant times exp(−μ[d(X,Y)−v|t|]). Here μ and v depend on the interaction, and the prefactor depends on the observables and their finite supports X and Y.

subject: math.MP
name: Lieb–Thirring inequality
statement: For a Schrödinger operator −Δ+V on Euclidean three-space with bounded real potential and negative part V₋ in L², its negative eigenvalues Eⱼ satisfy ∑ⱼ |Eⱼ|¹⁄² ≤ L ∫ V₋(x)² dx for a universal finite constant L.

subject: math.MP
name: Hellmann–Feynman theorem
statement: For a differentiable family of finite-dimensional Hermitian matrices A(t) with a differentiable normalized eigenvector ψ(t) and eigenvalue E(t), the derivative is E′(t) = ⟨ψ(t), A′(t)ψ(t)⟩.
